hard_class_invariants.statement: CPI score is a deterministic function of (ledger_records, window, weights); identical inputs always produce identical output.
Every CPIScorer invocation writes a PRESSURE_SNAPSHOT to the HMAC-chained ledger before returning; failure raises CPILedgerError.
A PRESSURE_ALERT ledger event is emitted whenever any domain score meets or exceeds the configured threshold; emission is never suppressed.
CPI reads only the HMAC-chained ledger; it never reads live system state, process memory, or external data sources.
Threshold configuration changes require a non-empty HUMAN-0 operator identity; empty/None operator is rejected with CPIAuthError.
